title: The Countdown to Azure Cosmos DB Conf 2026 Starts Now
content: April 28 is coming fast. We've published a full preview of what to expect — from cutting-edge AI agent architectures to production-hardened data modeling and everything in between. Read the preview. Also, want in on the action early? The #nosql channel on the Azure Open Source Discord is live — connect with the community, talk sessions, and get hyped with us.

title: Meet the Speakers for Azure Cosmos DB Conf 2026!
content: We're proud to announce our speaker lineup for Azure Cosmos DB Conf 2026, presented in partnership with AMD! Thanks to AMD's support, we've expanded the show to a full 5 hours — 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM PST. This year's roster brings together world-class speakers from across the community — covering AI and RAG architectures, vector search, MCP servers, security, data modeling, distributed systems, and more. Meet the speakers and see who's joining us on April 28, 2026.

title: Welcome AMD — Our Headline Partner for Azure Cosmos DB Conf 2026!
content: We're excited to welcome AMD as a partner for Azure Cosmos DB Conf 2026! Thank you, AMD, for your support of the Azure Cosmos DB community. Register now to join us on April 28, 2026.

title: Azure Cosmos DB Conf 2026 Call for Proposals Has Closed!
content: The Azure Cosmos DB Conf 2026 Call for Proposals is now closed. Thank you to everyone who submitted a session proposal! We're reviewing submissions and expect to announce the first wave of speakers within a few weeks. In the meantime, register now to receive event updates and reminders.

title: Azure Cosmos DB Conf 2026 Call for Proposals Closing Soon!
content: The Azure Cosmos DB Conf 2026 Call for Proposals closes soon on February 21, 2026. This is your last chance to submit your session ideas and share your real-world experiences, demos, and lessons with the global Azure Cosmos DB community on April 28, 2026. Don’t miss the opportunity to be part of the lineup. Submit your proposal here.

title: Azure Cosmos DB Conf 2026 Call for Proposals Now Open!
content: The Azure Cosmos DB Conf 2026 Call for Proposals is now open through February 21, 2026. Submit your session ideas and share your real-world experiences, demos, and lessons with the global Azure Cosmos DB community on April 28, 2026. Submit a proposal.

title: Register today for Azure Cosmos DB Conf 2026
content: Registration is open. Register now to receive event updates and reminders.

title: Coming Soon: Azure Cosmos DB Conf 2026!
content: Announcements are on the way, including the Call for Proposals. Save the date for April 28, 2026, and get ready to share, learn, and connect with the Azure Cosmos DB community.
